market.question: Will the highest temperature in Buenos Aires be 24°C on April 30?

assessment.reasoning: End-of-April Buenos Aires daily highs are forecast around 19-20°C (climate avg ~19-22°C); recent multi-day forecast suggests 19.1°C high near month end. 24°C is well above the forecast/seasonal mean and would require an unusual warm spell. Probability is low; market 0.29 looks high.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Possibility of an unforecast warm front pushing temps several °C above forecast
